name: reverse crunch kick
description: A reverse crunch finished with a leg kick upward, hitting the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Kick your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly and bend your knees again.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to lift.
